pr_title: planner: reject non-top sort for MPP
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/28812 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: reject the non-top sort for MPP.  the top sort means that there are no hash join or hash agg on the top of a sort, so the sort should be executed to guarantee order. However, the non-top sort is unnecessary, and is hard to be executed in MPP mode. 

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:

introduce `rejectSort` item in PhysicalProperty, which means the children operator can reject order.  We can set `rejectSort` be true under hash agg, hash join, union and sort.

issue_context.title: planner: remove unnecessary sort under hash agg
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
```

mysql> create table t (id int, name char(20), money double);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.10 sec)

mysql> select count(*) from (select id, money from t order by 1)a;
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        0 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc select count(*) from (select id, money from t order by 1)a;
+----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| id                         | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                  |
+----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| HashAgg_7                  | 1.00     | root      |               | funcs:count(1)->Column#5       |
| └─Sort_9                   | 10000.00 | root      |               | test.t.id                      |
|   └─TableReader_12         | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_11          |
|     └─TableFullScan_11     | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t       | keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
+----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```
**the Sort_9 is unnecessary, the planner should remove it to reduce cost. Moreover, it blocks upper operators being pushed down in following cases.**
```
mysql> alter table t set tiflash replica 1;
mysql> set @@tidb_isolation_read_engines='tiflash,tidb'; set @@tidb_allow_mpp=1; set @@tidb_enforce_mpp=1;

mysql> desc select count(distinct id) from (select id, money from t)a;
+------------------------------------+----------+-------------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
| id                                 | estRows  | task              | access object | operator info                             |
+------------------------------------+----------+-------------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
| TableReader_31                     | 1.00     | root              |               | data:ExchangeSender_30                    |
| └─ExchangeSender_30                | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               | ExchangeType: PassThrough                 |
|   └─Projection_26                  | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               | Column#5                                  |
|     └─HashAgg_27                   | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               | funcs:count(distinct test.t.id)->Column#5 |
|       └─ExchangeReceiver_29        | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               |                                           |
|         └─ExchangeSender_28        | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               | ExchangeType: PassThrough                 |
|           └─HashAgg_25             | 1.00     | batchCop[tiflash] |               | group by:test.t.id,                       |
|             └─TableFullScan_16     | 10000.00 | batchCop[tiflash] | table:t       | keep order:false, stats:pseudo            |
+------------------------------------+----------+-------------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
8 rows in set, 2 warnings (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc select count(distinct id) from (select id, money from t order by 1)a;
+----------------------------+----------+--------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
| id                         | estRows  | task         | access object | operator info                             |
+----------------------------+----------+--------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
| StreamAgg_8                | 1.00     | root         |               | funcs:count(distinct test.t.id)->Column#5 |
| └─Sort_13                  | 10000.00 | root         |               | test.t.id                                 |
|   └─TableReader_12         | 10000.00 | root         |               | data:TableFullScan_11                     |
|     └─TableFullScan_11     | 10000.00 | cop[tiflash] | table:t       | keep order:false, stats:pseudo            |
+----------------------------+----------+--------------+---------------+-------------------------------------------+
4 rows in set, 5 warnings (0.00 sec)
```

review_comments: This change would not only affect the MPP side?

yes, the non-MPP cases do not care about the `RejectSort` item.  only[ MPP tasks reject sort](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/28924/files#diff-d3d0144d9fe67ce1ca77fb02c6ebb7895cade0809e47b21b926bfa29feb0efb2R2755)
